messages.author: 1354f0aaefd7d429
messages.subject: ggplot2 0.8.3 binary for OS X
parts:
The page for ggplot2 on CRAN lists binary packages for various
architectures. Strangely, the binary for OS X refers to file
ggplot2_0.8.2.tgz. Is this a bug or is there no updated binary package
for OS X?

http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ggplot2/index.html

Package source: ggplot2_0.8.3.tar.gz
MacOS X binary: ggplot2_0.8.2.tgz <------ ??
Windows binary: ggplot2_0.8.3.zip
Reference manual: ggplot2.pdf

-- Christian

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 0.8.3 binary for OS X
parts:
Found the problem - mac R was being particularly picky when it came to
reshape. I've fixed the problem, so it should be available on mirrors
in the next couple of days.

Regards,

By the way, anyone anxious to get going with 0.8.3 before the Mac OS X
binary is available can install from the CRAN source by:

install.packages('ggplot2',type='source')
